verdicts.reason: Booking request met with a welcome and a relevant first-visit question.
User confirmed first visit; bot sensibly asks what they need help with.
User answered the help question; moving on to doctor preference is a sensible next step.
Ignores the user: they asked to take back their reason and gave a new one, bot repeats prior reply with no acknowledgement.
User had no doctor in mind; bot suggests one and asks about days.
Acknowledges the doctor choice and re-asks days, which the user had not yet answered.
Invents an acknowledgement: says no evening slots though the user never asked for evenings.
Invents an acknowledgement: says no morning slots though the user never asked for mornings.
Asks what was already answered: user just said Saturday, bot asks which days work.
User said Saturday; bot lists Saturday slots and asks which one.
User picked the 11:00 on the nearest Saturday; bot confirms that slot.
